stem:
Quadrilateral PQRS is dilated with the origin as the center of dilation to create quadrilateral P'Q'R'S'. The coordinates of each vertex are integers.

Which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: Each side length of quadrilateral PQRS is \frac{1}{2} the corresponding side length of quadrilateral P'Q'R'S'.

options.label: B
options.text: Quadrilateral P'Q'R'S' is congruent to quadrilateral PQRS.

options.label: C
options.text: Each angle measure of quadrilateral PQRS is \frac{1}{2} the corresponding angle measure of quadrilateral P'Q'R'S'.

options.label: D
options.text: Quadrilateral P'Q'R'S' is similar to quadrilateral PQRS.

visual_elements: Graph showing quadrilateral PQRS and its dilation quadrilateral P'Q'R'S' with vertices labeled.
